title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Apple Leaves for Nanopore Sequencing
author: Anthony Venon
materials: Equilibrate a QIAGEN Genomic-tip 100/G column with 4 mL of Buffer QBT.

Once all the lysate has passed through the column, wash the QIAGEN Genomic-tip 100/G column with 8 mL of Buffer QC. Wait until all the buffer flows through the column and repeat the wash with another of Buffer 8 mL of Buffer QC.
To each pellet, add 12 mL of G2 buffer, from the QIAGEN Blood and Cell Culture DNA Maxi Kit. Place it at 4 °C Overnight .
Once the tube of dissolved DNA has passed the column, repeat with the second tube of dissolved pellet with the same QIAGEN Genomic-tip 100/G column.
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare Carlson lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL Carlson lysis buffer per sample containing 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 9.5, 2 % w/v CTAB, 1.4 M NaCl, 1 % w/v PEG 8000 and 20 mM EDTA; buffers can be batched (1–2 L) and prepared at least one day in advance.

steps.title: Pre‑warm lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Warm the Carlson buffer to 65 °C in a water bath or incubator for 30 minutes before use.

steps.title: Collect and freeze leaf material
steps.instruction: Collect four leaves per tree, remove any aphids, flash‑freeze the leaves and store at –80 °C for long‑term conservation.

steps.title: Grind frozen leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Add 3–4 frozen leaf samples to a mortar cooled with liquid nitrogen and grind to a fine, homogeneous powder, keeping the material cold by adding liquid nitrogen as needed.

steps.title: Aliquot powdered tissue
steps.instruction: Split the powder into two equal portions and transfer each half to a fresh 50 mL Falcon tube; keep the tubes on liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer to tissue
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 20 mL of the pre‑warmed Carlson lysis buffer to each Falcon tube containing the powdered leaf material.

steps.title: Add β‑mercaptoethanol
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL β‑mercaptoethanol to each tube and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL RNase A to each tube and vortex for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a water bath or incubator at 65 °C for 1 h 30 min; every 30 min gently invert the tubes 10 times. At the 1 h point start an empty centrifuge at 4 °C, low speed (~500 rpm) to pre‑cool the instrument for the next centrifugation step.

steps.title: Cool lysate
steps.instruction: Allow the tubes to cool for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 20 mL chloroform to each tube and vortex in two pulses of 5 seconds each.

steps.title: Centrifuge chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 3500 × g, 4 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 0.7 × the volume of the lysate of isopropanol, invert the tube 10 times, then incubate at –80 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 3500 × g, 4 °C for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, carefully transfer the top (aqueous) layer of each tube to a new 50 mL Falcon tube using a P5000 pipette with wide‑bore tips, avoiding disturbance of the interphase.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the remaining liquid without disturbing the DNA pellet; wipe tube walls with absorbent wipes to remove residual liquid.

steps.title: Dissolve pellet in G2 buffer and load column
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in G2 buffer (volume sufficient to fully dissolve) and pour the solution through an equilibrated QIAGEN Genomic‑tip 100/G column, allowing flow by gravity.

steps.title: Centrifuge column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 3500 × g, 4 °C for 45 minutes to collect the bound DNA.

steps.title: Pre‑warm Buffer QF
steps.instruction: Warm Buffer QF to 55 °C using a water bath or incubator.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Place the Genomic‑tip over a clean 50 mL Falcon tube and elute the genomic DNA with 5 mL pre‑warmed Buffer QF.

steps.title: Cool eluate
steps.instruction: Allow the eluate to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation of eluate
steps.instruction: Add 3.5 mL isopropanol to the eluate and invert the tube 10 times to mix.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at –20 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol to the pelleted DNA and slowly invert the tube 10 times.

steps.title: Final centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3500 × g, 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet, wipe tube walls dry, then resuspend the DNA in 100 µL TE buffer and incubate at room temperature, typically overnight.

steps.title: Size‑select DNA for Nanopore
steps.instruction: Perform the Nanopore size‑selection protocol as described by the manufacturer.
